items.source: Special adapter for Springs FactoryBean interface to allow easy setup of repository factories via Spring configuration.
items.translation: Spring 专用适配器，用于 FactoryBean 接口，以便通过 Spring 配置轻松设置存储库工厂。

items.source: An interface that can be added to any repository so that queries can be enriched by conditions of the Cypher-DSL.
items.translation: 一种可添加到任何存储库的接口，以便通过 Cypher-DSL 的 conditions 来丰富查询。

items.source: Bean post-processor that automatically applies persistence exception translation to all methods returning either Mono or Flux of any bean marked with Spring's @Repository annotation, adding a corresponding AbstractPointcutAdvisor to the exposed proxy (either an existing AOP proxy or a newly generated proxy that implements all of the target's interfaces).
items.translation: 这是一个自动为所有返回 `Mono` 或 `Flux` 的方法应用持久化异常翻译的 Bean 后处理器，适用于所有标记有 Spring 的 `@Repository` 注解的 Bean。该处理器会向暴露的代理（无论是现有的 AOP 代理还是新创建的、实现目标类所有接口的代理）添加相应的 `AbstractPointcutAdvisor`。

items.source: An interface that can be added to any imperative repository so that the repository exposes several methods taking in a Statement from the Cypher-DSL, that allows for full customization of the queries executed in a programmatic way in contrast to provide custom queries declaratively via @Query annotations.
items.translation: 一种可添加到任何命令式存储库的接口，该接口使存储库能够暴露若干方法，这些方法接收来自 Cypher-DSL 的 Statement 对象，从而允许以编程方式完全自定义执行的查询，这与通过 @Query 注解以声明式方式提供自定义查询形成对比。

items.source: An interface that can be added to any reactive repository so that the repository exposes several methods taking in a Statement from the Cypher-DSL, that allows for full customization of the queries executed in a programmatic way in contrast to provide custom queries declaratively via @Query annotations.
items.translation: 一个可添加到任何反应式存储库的接口，该接口使存储库能够暴露多个方法，这些方法接收来自 Cypher-DSL 的 Statement，从而允许以编程方式完全自定义执行的查询，这与通过 @Query 注解以声明方式提供自定义查询形成对比。

items.source: Neo4j specific contract for entity informations.
items.translation: Neo4j 专用的 实体信息 契约。

items.source: The CDI pendant to the Neo4jRepositoryFactoryBean.
items.translation: CDI 挂靠在 Neo4jRepositoryFactoryBean 上。

items.source:
<!-- tag::intent[] --> This package provides a couple of public support classes for
building custom imperative and reactive Spring Data Neo4j repository base classes. The
support classes are the same classes used by SDN itself. <!-- end::intent[] -->
items.translation: <!-- tag::intent[] --> 本包提供了一些公共支持类，用于构建自定义的指令式和响应式 Spring Data Neo4j 存储库基类。这些支持类与 SDN 自身所使用的类相同。<!-- end::intent[] -->

items.source:
This package provides the Neo4j imperative and reactive
repository API.
items.translation: 该包提供了 Neo4j 命令式和响应式仓库 API。

items.source:
Configuration infrastructure for Neo4j specific repositories,
especially dedicated annotations to enable imperative and reactive Spring Data Neo4j
repositories.
items.translation: 为 Neo4j 专用仓库配置基础设施，特别是通过专用注解来启用命令式和响应式 Spring Data Neo4j 仓库。

items.source: A set of annotations for providing custom queries to repositories.
items.translation: 用于向仓库提供自定义查询的一组注解。

items.source:
This class registers the Neo4j SpEL Support it is registered by the appropriate
repository factories as a root bean.
items.translation: 该类注册了 Neo4j SpEL 支持，并由相应的仓库工厂将其注册为根 Bean。
